shared_elements: schematic incised/low-relief decoration on an anthropomorph-shaped monolith
circular/disc motif set centrally on the front
paired symmetrical elements flanking a central object
horizontal band/register dividing the lower part of the surface
small framed panels with geometric (cross/hatched) infill
strict bilateral symmetry about a vertical axis
justification: Both surfaces present a bilaterally symmetrical, purely schematic scheme on a vertically oriented anthropomorph-shaped block, with a central circular/rectangular object flanked by paired motifs and a horizontal banded register with geometric infill below. The decisive difference is that B explicitly depicts a human figure with head, face, hair, arms and pendant ornaments, whereas A depicts no body parts at all, only a framed handled object and grid panels within a bordered field.
